sentences.text:
=
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Lal Bahadur Singh, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Nirmal Kumar Sinha, App.

======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Anjani Kumar Sharan
 Oral Order
2 23-03-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 323, 504, 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Allegedly, petitioner is said to have sold the land by making forged and fabricated documents by showing the informant (father) dead in the sale deed as late Naresh Prasad Soni.
After some arguments, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw this application.
Accordingly, this application is dismissed as withdrawn.

However, if the petitioner surrenders before the learned Patna High Court CR. MISC. No. 72972 of 2022(2) dt.23-03-2023 Court below within six weeks from today and seeks regular bail, the learned Court below shall pass order on the same day in accordance with law without being prejudiced by this order.

(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) divyanshi/-
